title: T2SGrid: Temporal-to-Spatial Gridification for Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: To address these issues, we propose Temporal to Spatial Gridification (T2SGrid), a novel framework that reformulates video temporal understanding as a spatial understanding task.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Unlike existing approaches that assign a timestamp to each individual frame, we associate a single composite text-based timestamp (e.g., “Frame 0 to 11”) with each grid image.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: The emergence of Vision-Large Language Models (Vision-LMMs) [2, 17, 22, 51, 53] has revolutionized visual understanding [50], exhibiting remarkable zero-shot reasoning [21, 25, 27, 33, 43, 56, 63, 69, 75, 79, 80] and multi-modal comprehension [13, 30, 38, 50, 76], primarily on static images.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: This leverages the model’s strong spatial reasoning capability for temporal understanding. ments within vast, unstructured video streams remains a fundamental challenge.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Visual frame numbering, which overlays timestamps directly on frames, degrades spatial detail and undermines the very visual features that Vision-LMMs rely on for semantic understanding.
